recipes.oracle_text:
Return target black creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Madness {0} (If you discard this card, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.)

recipe_coverage: Oracle-reviewed single-card recovery: eligible alternatives and full-zone indices, type/color/value restrictions, graveyard ownership, exact/insufficient mana, empty zone, ordered unaffected zones, target departure and index shift through a real Reclaim response, populated-zone snapshot replay. Reanimation also checks entry characteristics and subsequent death ownership; subtype bonuses are explicit. Multi-target recovery, graveyard shroud, replacement effects, and exceptional card types remain separate. This declaration tests the normal hand-cast recovery component; Madness remains separate.
